name: linkding
summary: Self-hosted bookmark manager: save, tag and search links, with a browser extension and an API.
description: linkding by Sascha Ißbrücker, run from its published container image. Bookmarks live in SQLite under the app data directory and survive redeploys.

arguments: D="$AUTOMATON_APP_DATA_DIR" && rm -rf "$D/code" && mkdir -p "$D/code" "$D/state/favicons" "$D/state/previews" "$D/state/assets" && cd /etc/linkding && for f in *; do [ "$f" = data ] || cp -r "$f" "$D/code/" || exit 1; done && ln -s /etc/linkding/.venv "$D/code/.venv" && ln -s "$D/state" "$D/code/data" && cd "$D/code" && python manage.py generate_secret_key && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py enable_wal && python manage.py create_initial_superuser && python manage.py migrate_tasks && { python manage.py run_huey -f & } && grep -vE "^(uid|gid) *=" uwsgi.ini > /tmp/uwsgi.ini && exec uwsgi --http "[::]:$AUTOMATON_PORT" /tmp/uwsgi.ini

secrets.name: LD_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password of the first administrator account (used when the database is created)

settings.name: LD_SUPERUSER_NAME
settings.description: Username of the first administrator account

settings.name: LD_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
settings.description: Address(es) you open linkding at, comma separated, e.g. https://app-<id>.apps.example.com (needed to sign in until Automaton passes the public host to apps; see the README)
